journal.extremedimensions.tethered.title: 1. Tethered
journal.extremedimensions.tethered.text: If you can read this, you are still held. Good. Most who find this book are not. There is a cord older than the mountains, woven through every living thing in this world. We called it the Tether. It does not speak. It does not need to. The Tether knows. Before you step through any wound, find a stone that remembers north.
journal.extremedimensions.anchor.title: 2. The Anchor
journal.extremedimensions.anchor.text: A stone that remembers north: chiseled stone, eight times, around a single diamond. The lodestone drinks what you give it and turns warm, like a hand. Coal, and the rods the breezes leave behind, for the burning place. Pearls and echoes for the pale one. Set it close to the wound, never far. An anchor too far from the wound is only a stone, and stones do not keep anyone alive.
journal.extremedimensions.cord.title: 3. The Cord
journal.extremedimensions.cord.text: Feeding the anchor is not enough. You must bind yourself to it. A length of iron chain, bound with two cords of string. Wrap it around the anchor and carry the other end through the wound. On this side the cord is short: five strides from the anchor and it snaps. Walk straight into the wound. Down there it trails behind you over the ground, and every step away from the wound pulls it tighter. Walk far and they drink faster. Tear a new wound closer to where you must go.
journal.extremedimensions.wound.title: 4. Wounds
journal.extremedimensions.wound.text: A portal is not a door. Doors are built. Portals are torn. Stand close and you will feel it pulling at the edges of you, the way a wound pulls at stitches. When the path between anchor and wound is blocked, the anchor bleeds into nothing. Keep the way open.
journal.extremedimensions.ember_deep.tex: Below the fire there is a heat that is not fire. The pigmen trade in gold and will not tell you why. I believe they are paying someone. Every breath down there costs warmth, and the anchor pays it for you. Count the seconds. They are counting too.
journal.extremedimensions.pale_void.text: There is no ground in the pale place, only islands that pretend. The tall ones watch you with too much interest. They do not attack because you look at them. They attack because you remind them. Of what, I did not want to know.
journal.extremedimensions.starved.title: 7. The Starved
journal.extremedimensions.starved.text: They are not demons. They were never demons. They are what is left when a soul stays too long where it was not anchored. Hungry for warmth they no longer make. When your anchor runs dry, they do not kill you. They drink. Killing is just what is left.
journal.extremedimensions.ended.title: 8. Ended
journal.extremedimensions.ended.text: I lost a companion beyond the wound today. Not to the hunger. To an ordinary blade. His anchor went cold the moment he fell, as if it had only ever been holding him. The Tether pulled him home empty. He woke in the grass and did not remember my name for an hour.
journal.extremedimensions.scars.title: 9. What They Keep
journal.extremedimensions.scars.text: Every return costs something. A little strength. A little warmth. A little of your name. The marks do not fade. They stay, and they gather, and every one makes room for the next. I think the Tether wants us to earn our wholeness back, piece by piece: by walking where they can see us, by coming home, by surviving the dark. And every death undoes half of what was earned.
journal.extremedimensions.fragment.title: 10. A Fragment
journal.extremedimensions.fragment.text: It fell from one of them, glowing the colour of soul fire. It hums against the anchor. It is a piece of the cord itself, frayed loose. Offered to an anchor, it mends. What it mends, and with whose soul, I prefer not to ask.
journal.extremedimensions.mending.title: 11. Mending
journal.extremedimensions.mending.text: I gave the fragment to the anchor and a mark on my soul closed like an eye. Somewhere, I am sure of it, someone else's opened. The Tether does not create. It only moves things.
journal.extremedimensions.weavers.title: 12. The Weavers
journal.extremedimensions.weavers.text: Deep under everything there are cities of black stone, built by hands that did not need light. In their center stands a great frame, and nothing in it. They did not build a portal. They tried to close one. They used the only thread strong enough. Themselves.
journal.extremedimensions.unanchored.tex: It dropped a pearl when it died, and in the pearl I saw a field of grass. Endermen carry blocks. They cannot bear water. They scream when you meet their eyes. I used to think they were thieves. Now I think they are trying to build something. An anchor. A way home.
journal.extremedimensions.habit.title: 14. Habit
journal.extremedimensions.habit.text: Five times through the wound and back. It gets easier, and that is the danger. The Tether held. It always holds. But I have started to feel it tighten when I leave, like it is reminding me who it belongs to.
journal.extremedimensions.silence.title: 15. Silence
journal.extremedimensions.silence.text: I asked the Tether what it wants. It did not answer. It never answers. But my anchor flared, and for a moment I heard a thousand voices hold their breath. Keep your anchors full. Not for you. For them.

menu.extremedimensions.quote.2: They did not die. They were woven.
menu.extremedimensions.quote.3: Feed the anchor, or they will feed on you.
menu.extremedimensions.quote.5: Gold does not buy mercy. Only time.
menu.extremedimensions.quote.6: Do not linger where the dead are hungry.
menu.extremedimensions.quote.7: Something guards the silence of the Weavers.
menu.extremedimensions.quote.8: Hold fast. Let go, and you are theirs.

menu.extremedimensions.quote.10: Count the seconds. They are counting too.

menu.extremedimensions.quote.12: Older than the mountains. Hungrier than the void.

journal.extremedimensions.tribe.title: 16. The Tribe
journal.extremedimensions.tribe.text: I am not the first to walk between the wounds. There was a tribe before us, long forgotten, that learned to live in the seams. They did not die. They thinned. Now they stand at the edge of the trees, on the ridge, on the far bank of the lava, and watch. It sees. It waits. It takes. Never meet its eyes for long. Never let it near your anchors. And if it comes closer while you are not looking, know that it does not hate you. It only wants what is yours.

journal.extremedimensions.soul_light.tex: I watched one drink. It held the light of my anchor like water in cupped hands, and I could do nothing. Then the wind turned, and the soul lantern by the gate flared blue, and it flinched. They will not drink where souls burn. Hang a soul lantern near your anchors. Light a soul campfire. It does not keep them away. It only keeps them thirsty.
journal.extremedimensions.ruined_gate.te: The broken portals in the wilds are not ruins. They are graves. Each was a wound someone opened without an anchor, and each one closed on them. I found a chain in the obsidian of one, still warm. I did not follow where it led.
journal.extremedimensions.first_wound.te: The tribe did not find the seams. They made them. The first wound was a door, cut so they could walk where nothing could follow. But a door works both ways, and something hungry came through, and they ran into the seams to hide. They have been hiding ever since. Watching. Waiting for it to forget them.

journal.extremedimensions.hollows.title: 20. The Hollows
journal.extremedimensions.hollows.text: I followed one. It ran, my compass clutched to its chest, and it did not vanish until it reached a hollow under the dark oaks: a barrel, bones, webs, candles nobody lights, and everything I had ever lost. They do not want our things. They want to remember what having things was like. A hoard whispers. Follow the ink in the air.
journal.extremedimensions.little_thieves: The hoards have children. Small, quick, grey as ash, and they giggle. They freeze when you look at them, like a game. Look away and your torches are gone. They are frightened of everything except soul light, and they love what the Tether leaves behind. I gave one a fragment by a soul lantern, and it has not left my side since.
journal.extremedimensions.keeper.title: 22. The Keeper
journal.extremedimensions.keeper.text: Every hoard has a keeper: older than the others, its mask bleached like bone. It does not watch. It does not wait. Touch what it guards and it comes, roaring, through the trees. Fight it near the hoard or run far. It will not follow you beyond what it keeps.

journal.extremedimensions.seam.title: 23. The Seam
journal.extremedimensions.seam.text: Between the wounds there is a place that is not a place. Islands of quiet stone hang in nothing, and the light comes from everywhere and nowhere. I stepped out of a gate of pale stone, and the rift I came through hangs between its pylons. It does not stay where I left it: it drifts, slowly, like a boat on a still lake, back and forth over the threshold. When the mist hides the gate, I look for the gold. No other light here is that colour. My chain is the only thing that knows the way back. Do not let go of it.
journal.extremedimensions.loom.title: 24. The Loom
journal.extremedimensions.loom.text: The Weavers were here. Their looms still stand: pillars of hush stone strung with silk as thick as rope, stretched between islands. The silk is warm. It hums when I touch it. I think they wove the Tether here, before anyone needed one.
journal.extremedimensions.thinned.title: 25. The Thinned
journal.extremedimensions.thinned.text: I found their village. Low houses, cold hearths, and graves: mounds of hush stone with a skull and a candle on each. The Lurkers that walk here do not steal. They only watch me, the way you watch a guest who arrived too late. This was their home before they had to hide in ours.

journal.extremedimensions.woven.title: 26. Woven
journal.extremedimensions.woven.text: Iron holds, but iron does not forgive. Silk does. I wove the Seam's thread through my chain by soul light, and the hunger behind me slowed, as if it could not quite find me. The Weavers' own weave goes further: when the charge runs dry, it comes apart thread by thread and carries you home instead. And every mark I endure to the end leaves a scar. Scars are harder to drink from.

journal.extremedimensions.seal.title: 27. The Seal
journal.extremedimensions.seal.text: The dragon was never the enemy. It was the lock. It coiled around the first wound like a scar around a cut, and we killed it for its egg and its breath. I felt the world crack when it fell. The tribe felt it too: they do not take any more. They leave things at the edges of our camps, like offerings to something they hope will protect them. Every rift now opens near the Heart of the Seam. Something there is waking.
journal.extremedimensions.storms.title: 28. Wound Storms
journal.extremedimensions.storms.text: The sky tore above the fields today. Not lightning: a seam, opening and closing like a mouth. Darkness rolled out of it, my anchors guttered, and things from the burning place and the pale one fell through and stood up in the grass. It lasted a minute. It will happen again, until someone mends what was broken.
journal.extremedimensions.heart.title: 29. The Heart
journal.extremedimensions.heart.text: Where all the threads meet, there is an altar of silk, and four stones around it that drink light. When I stood on the altar it rose: tall, white as bone, thin as hunger. It bites through the thread that leads you home. It drags you close when it is dying. But feed the stones silk, two at once, and the light pins it down. And the Thinned fight beside those who were kind to their young.
journal.extremedimensions.wanderer.title: 30. The Wanderer
journal.extremedimensions.wanderer.text: You have been reading my journal all this time and never asked who wrote it. I was the first to bind a tether, and the first to walk the seams, and the last of the tribe who did not thin. I wrote this for whoever came after, because someone always does. Now it is yours to finish. Mend it, and the world forgets the wound. Sever it, and the world forgets the Tether. I could never choose. You must.
journal.extremedimensions.ending.title: 31. The Ending
journal.extremedimensions.ending.text: It is done. Whatever was chosen, it was chosen for all of us. If it was mended: the storms are gone, the tribe brings gifts instead of taking, and the wounds bleed slower. If it was severed: the Tether no longer counts our seconds beyond the wound, but whoever falls there loses everything they carried, forever. Either way, the journal ends here. The story does not.

gui.extremedimensions.choice.timeout: You did not choose: the Tether chose a curse for you.

A leash of trust is the first thing the Starved chew through.

penalty.extremedimensions.unwatched.lore: Even looking cannot keep them where they stand.

gui.extremedimensions.settings.title: Settings
gui.extremedimensions.settings.reduce_fl: No strobes, shaking or glitches: flashes become soft fades and pulses hold still.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.colour_bl: The four curse sets take colours that stay apart for every kind of colour blindness. Their sigils always differ in shape too.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.meters.de: The corner where the anchor and tether meters and the guide sit.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.timer.des: Where the mod's own timer panel sits when the server shows the expedition timer as its own panel instead of a boss bar: at the top of the screen, or just above the hotbar.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.hud_scale: Size of the meters, the guide and the timer.
A small card that names the next step of your first expedition, until you are back home. Open the chat (T) to close it with its ×.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.hints.des: A short hint in the corner the first time you meet each part of the mod. The world can turn them off for everyone.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.menu.desc: What the title screen and the loading screens bring: the picture of the Tether and its music (Tick of the Boundary on the menus, Ominous Loading Screen while a world loads, until you stand in it), only one of them, or Minecraft's own.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.display_n: These options stay on this computer and follow you to every world.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.world_not: Changes take effect at once and are saved in the server's config.
Outside a world: this computer's config, used by your singleplayer worlds.
Only operators can change the world's rules.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.tip_max: %s: the most stacks it can reach (0 = never offered). Lowering it never takes stacks away.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.tip_per_s: %s: its strength per stack, the number on its card.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.refused: Not taken: %s (needs a number of 0 or more).
gui.extremedimensions.settings.not_allow: Only operators can change the world's rules.
gui.extremedimensions.settings.section.d: After the Dragon and the Mending
gui.extremedimensions.guide.title: First expedition
gui.extremedimensions.guide.1: Set a lodestone within 5 blocks of a Nether portal and feed it coal: it becomes an anchor.
gui.extremedimensions.guide.2: Craft a Tether (iron chain and two string) and use it on the anchor to bind yourself.
gui.extremedimensions.guide.3: Walk straight into the portal: the tether snaps five strides from its anchor.
gui.extremedimensions.guide.4: Come back through the same portal before the timer runs out.
gui.extremedimensions.guide.done: You came back. From here on, the Tether Journal leads the way.
config.extremedimensions.max_charge.desc: Maximum charge one player can store in a single anchor, in seconds (1800 = 30 minutes).
config.extremedimensions.portal_range.de: An anchor only works within this many blocks of a portal of its type.
config.extremedimensions.link_range.desc: Anchors within this many blocks of the portal you enter feed your expedition.
config.extremedimensions.hud_range.desc: The anchor meters appear in the HUD within this many blocks of a charged anchor.
Players within this many blocks see an anchor's particles.
config.extremedimensions.blocked_leak_pe: Charge (in seconds) an anchor loses per second while its path to its portal is blocked.
config.extremedimensions.tether_item_cha: Charge granted at once by an Ember Tether or Void Tether, in seconds (600 = 10 minutes).
config.extremedimensions.base_drain.desc: Charge drained per second beyond the wound, before curses and distance are applied (1 = one second of charge per second).
config.extremedimensions.tether_distance: Every this many blocks you are from your arrival portal adds +100%% drain.
config.extremedimensions.leech_seconds.d: Below this much charge (in seconds) the Leeching starts: souls are visibly pulled out of you.
config.extremedimensions.collapse_pull_t: Length of the Collapse pull (the player is dragged out of the dimension) before the death, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.extremedimensions.bounce_grace_ti: Ticks before a dormant portal is checked again after it sent you back (you entered without a working anchor).
config.extremedimensions.respawn_title.d: 1 = a big title ("The Tether Tightens", "Expedition Ended") on respawn after a death that costs a curse; 0 = none.
config.extremedimensions.hud_boss_bar: Expedition timer as a boss bar
config.extremedimensions.hud_boss_bar.de: 1 = the time left on an expedition shows as a boss bar at the top of the screen, stacked with any other as Minecraft stacks them (a Rift Trial gets a second bar under it); 0 = the mod's own timer panel, placed by the HUD settings.
gui.extremedimensions.toast.journal: New page in the Tether Journal
gui.extremedimensions.warm_chain.found: The chain is warm to the touch.
gui.extremedimensions.warm_chain.crossed: Somewhere close, the chain is still being held.
config.extremedimensions.own_worlds_only: 1 = the mod acts only in the Overworld, the Nether, the End and the Seam: in another mod's world your curses sleep, an expedition waits for your return, and nothing of the mod spawns or strikes there. 0 = it acts in every world.
config.extremedimensions.rope_segment.de: A new chain segment is laid every this many blocks walked.
config.extremedimensions.rope_max_segmen: Maximum chain segments per player; after that the oldest segment disappears.
config.extremedimensions.tether_break_ra: In the Overworld the Tether snaps beyond this distance (in blocks) from its anchor.
config.extremedimensions.tether_portal_s: Standing within this many blocks of the anchor's portal never snaps the Tether.
config.extremedimensions.offer_count.des: Cards offered after a Collapse or a death beyond the wound.
config.extremedimensions.offer_delay_tic: Ticks after respawning before the curse screen opens.
config.extremedimensions.overworld_curse: 1 = the Overworld set of curses is offered and acts in the Overworld in every world, unless its operators turn it off with /tether overworld_penalties off. 0 = it waits until they turn it on.
config.extremedimensions.curse_runes.des: 1: a curse a player has never carried shows its name and its effect only in runes, on its card and in the Curses screen, until they have taken it once (as on Hard and Extreme). 0: every curse reads plainly from the start (Easy, Normal). The Extreme set only ever hints at what it does.
gui.extremedimensions.curses.unknown: Unknown. Take it once to read it.
gui.extremedimensions.choice.unknown: Take it to learn what it does.
config.extremedimensions.offer_timeout_s: Curse offer: chosen for you after (s)
Seconds an offer of curse cards may stand unanswered before the Tether chooses one itself (0 = never).
config.extremedimensions.multiplier_chan: Chance that an offer is multiplied (0.15 = 15%%): every card then carries its own multiplier between the min and max below.
Lowest multiplier a card in a multiplied offer can carry.
Highest multiplier a card in a multiplied offer can carry.
config.extremedimensions.idle_ticks.desc: Ticks without looking around or without moving before a player counts as idle and earns no atonement (300 = 15 s).
config.extremedimensions.active_move.des: Horizontal blocks a player must move to count as active.
config.extremedimensions.atone_per_minut: Atonement points per minute of active play on an expedition.
config.extremedimensions.atone_per_elite: Atonement points per elite slain beyond the wound.
config.extremedimensions.atone_per_retur: Atonement points per safe return from an expedition.
config.extremedimensions.atone_return_mi: Active seconds beyond the wound an expedition needs before its safe return counts and earns atonement.
config.extremedimensions.atone_per_day.d: Atonement points per Overworld day survived without dying.
config.extremedimensions.atone_night_act: Active seconds in a night a player needs for its dawn to earn atonement (idling or sleeping it away earns none).
config.extremedimensions.atone_per_night: Atonement points per hostile mob slain at night in the Overworld.
config.extremedimensions.atone_death_los: Share of every curse's atonement a death takes away (0.5 = half, 0 = none, 1 = all).
config.extremedimensions.atone_base.desc: Atonement points needed to lift a curse's last stack.
config.extremedimensions.atone_per_stack: Extra atonement points needed for every stack a curse has above its last one.
config.extremedimensions.extreme_card_ch: Chance that one card of an offer is an Extreme curse, which is never multiplied (0.025 = 2.5%%).
config.extremedimensions.extreme_spill_w: How likely a spilled stack (from a multiplied card whose curse is full) lands on an Extreme curse compared to any other curse. 1 = as likely, 0 = never.
config.extremedimensions.extreme_atone_f: Extreme curses take this many times the atonement points and Tether Fragments to lift (2 = double).
config.extremedimensions.storm_strike_mi: Stormcalled: shortest time in seconds between lightning strikes while a storm finds the player under open sky (each wait is random between min and max).
config.extremedimensions.storm_strike_ma: Stormcalled: longest time in seconds between lightning strikes while a storm finds the player under open sky (each wait is random between min and max).
1: the Abyssal curses, the Extreme set's heavier layer, can be dealt (Hard and Extreme switch them on; an operator may on Easy and Normal too). 0: never.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_card_ch: Chance that one card of an offer is an Abyssal curse (0.01 = 1%%), where they are switched on.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_forced_: Chance that an Abyssal card is then the whole offer, with no other card to choose (Extreme: 0.25).
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_after_c: How many Collapses a player must have been through before an Abyssal card can come.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_max_car: How many Abyssal curses a player carries at most; with that many, no more are dealt.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_atone_f: Abyssal curses take this many times the atonement points to lift without their deed (4 = four times).
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_fragmen: Tether Fragments it takes at an anchor to lift a stack of an Abyssal curse.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_death_l: Share of an Abyssal curse's atonement a death takes away (1 = all of it).
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_mending: Whether a Mending Cloth lifts an Abyssal curse (1) or not (0).
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_s: Undead slain in daylight that break Sunscorn.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_g: Days without dying that break Gravebound.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_m: Withers slain that break Marrow Rot.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_w: Weight of Iron: Elders to slay
Elders slain in at most two pieces of iron or better that break Weight of Iron.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_l: Monsters slain while hungry (hunger at 6 or less) that break Lockjaw.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_t: Nether Stars offered at an anchor that break The Hungering.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_c: Times the Ferryman must fall to break Cinder Lungs.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_m: Monsters slain with arrows or a trident that break Mirror Wound.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_b: Stacks of other curses lifted while Blood Price holds that break it.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_r: Rotten flesh eaten that breaks Rot.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_c: Covetous: stolen things to take back
Stacks a Lurker took under Covetous that must be back in the player's hands to break it.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_r: Monsters slain that break Restless Dead.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_s: Blows blocked with a shield that break Splintering.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_b: Zombie villagers cured near the player that break Bitter Cure.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_f: Hollowlings bound to the player that break Forsaken Bond.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_blood_p: How long the maximum health a lifted stack costs under Blood Price stays gone.
Chance that a stack lifted under Blood Price jumps to another curse instead (0.33 = a third).
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_restles: Seconds before a monster slain under Restless Dead rises again.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_unmoore: How far a blow in the End can throw a player with Unmoored.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_l: Nights in a row in the Overworld kept awake through that break Lightless.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_u: Safe returns from expeditions that break Unmapped.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_c: Items taken out of furnaces that break Cold Forge.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_break_b: Ripe crops harvested that break Barren Hand.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_lightle: How far round a player with Lightless monsters spawn as if the light were dimmer.
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_cold_fo: Times the fuel a furnace worked under Cold Forge burns (2 = twice as fast).
config.extremedimensions.abyssal_cave_in: Below this height, stone mined under Cave-In may bring the block above down.
config.extremedimensions.atone_kill_min_: Kills only earn atonement for naturally spawned monsters the player dealt at least this share of the damage to (0.5 = half); a farm's fall does not count.
config.extremedimensions.atone_kill_area: Kill atonement is capped per place: once the kill limit is reached within this many blocks during the time window, that place gives nothing.
Kills in one place (within the kill area radius) that still earn atonement during the time window; after that, that place gives nothing.
Length in minutes of the time window for the per-place kill limit.
config.extremedimensions.fragment_cost_p: Tether Fragments a mending at an anchor costs per stack the curse has (3 stacks = 3 fragments).
config.extremedimensions.veil_wing_extra: Chance that a Veil Ray drops a second Veil Wing (0.35 = 35%%).
config.extremedimensions.fragment_chance: Chance that a hostile mob killed by a player beyond the wound drops a Tether Fragment (0.04 = 4%%).
Fragment drop chance for Wither Skeletons, Endermen, Blazes, Ghasts and Shulkers (0.12 = 12%%).
config.extremedimensions.warm_chain_chan: Chance a ruined portal in the Overworld has a warm chain lying into it (0.35 = 35%%). Each ruined portal is looked at once, the first time a player comes near.
config.extremedimensions.hints.desc: A short hint as a toast the first time a player meets each part of the mod: a Collapse, a curse, the Lurker, a hoard, a relic, the Seam Needle, an Elder, a storm and more (1 on, 0 off). Each player can also turn them off for themselves under Display.
config.extremedimensions.frame_silk: First Weaver: silk for the frame
config.extremedimensions.frame_silk.desc: Seam Silk it takes to string the frame of an Ancient City, the start of the First Weaver's trail.
config.extremedimensions.first_knot_dist: About how far (blocks) from the Heart the First Knot hangs in the Fray, beside the first island found there.
config.extremedimensions.knot_mother_rel: Relics the Knot Mother always leaves.
config.extremedimensions.knot_mother_res: Minutes before the Knot Mother can be woken again once she is slain (0 = at once).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_spawn_ch: Chance per player every 20 seconds that a Lurker appears (Overworld and Nether), outside the cooldown (0.012 = 1.2%%).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_cooldown: Minimum seconds between two Lurker encounters for the same player.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_drain_ch: Chance that an appearance in the Overworld is a Lurker draining a nearby charged anchor (0.15 = 15%%).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_stalk_ch: Chance that a watching Lurker comes closer to take something instead of leaving (0.15 = 15%%).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_watch_mi: Shortest time in seconds a Lurker watches before it leaves or comes closer (random between min and max).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_watch_ma: Longest time in seconds a Lurker watches before it leaves or comes closer (random between min and max).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_drain_pe: Charge (in seconds) drained per second while a Lurker drinks an anchor.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_drain_se: How long at most a Lurker drinks an anchor, in seconds.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_xp_fract: Share of the player's levels a Lurker takes (0.3 = 30%%).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_item_ran: From how many blocks away a stalking Lurker can steal an item from you (0 = never). It strikes as soon as you are within the largest of the four reaches, and only picks what reaches you at that moment.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_xp_range: From how many blocks away a stalking Lurker can take levels from you (0 = never). It strikes as soon as you are within the largest of the four reaches, and only picks what reaches you at that moment.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_armor_ra: From how many blocks away a stalking Lurker can take armor from you (0 = never). It strikes as soon as you are within the largest of the four reaches, and only picks what reaches you at that moment.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_curse_ra: From how many blocks away a stalking Lurker can lay a curse on you (0 = never). It strikes as soon as you are within the largest of the four reaches, and only picks what reaches you at that moment.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_item_wei: How likely a striking Lurker is to steal an item, relative to the other three weights (only what is in reach and possible counts).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_xp_weigh: How likely a striking Lurker is to take levels, relative to the other three weights (only what is in reach and possible counts).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_armor_we: How likely a striking Lurker is to take armor, relative to the other three weights (only what is in reach and possible counts).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_curse_we: How likely a striking Lurker is to lay a curse, relative to the other three weights (only what is in reach and possible counts).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_ward_ran: Soul light (lanterns, torches, campfires, fire) within this many blocks wards an anchor against draining. 0 = off.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_animal_w: Chance per watching Lurker every 5 seconds that wolves and cats near its target growl or hiss towards it (0.6 = 60%%).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_run_seco: Seconds a Lurker runs off with its loot before it vanishes; kill it in time to get the loot back.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_watch_di: Closest distance in blocks at which a watching Lurker shows itself.
Furthest distance in blocks at which a watching Lurker shows itself.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_stalk_sp: Speed multiplier of a stalking Lurker at the start: it starts slow and speeds up as it closes in.
Speed multiplier a stalking Lurker reaches as it closes in: it starts slow and speeds up as it gets nearer.
config.extremedimensions.lurker_run_spee: Speed multiplier of a fleeing Lurker at full run, reached after a short burst of acceleration.
config.extremedimensions.hoard_wild_chan: Chance every 30 seconds, in a dark forest, pale garden or soul sand valley, that an old hoard lies nearby (0.08 = 8%%).
config.extremedimensions.hoard_wreck_min: Minutes (of the world's time) after a hoard is wrecked before a new one may nest within 256 blocks of it.
config.extremedimensions.hollowlings_per: Number of Hollowlings that play around a hoard while someone is near.
config.extremedimensions.hollowling_resp: Seconds before a killed Hollowling is replaced by another; several killed come back one at a time, each a full wait after the last.
config.extremedimensions.hollowling_bond: Chance that a Tether Fragment, offered in soul light, earns a Hollowling's trust (0.4 = 40%%).
config.extremedimensions.companion_gift_: Minutes of play between the things a companion Hollowling brings you.
config.extremedimensions.companion_guard: Chance that a companion Hollowling chases off a Lurker about to take something from you (0.6 = 60%%).
1 = hoards are guarded by a Keeper, 0 = never.
config.extremedimensions.soul_woven_drai: Drain multiplier with a Soul-Woven Tether (0.85 = 15%% slower drain).
config.extremedimensions.seam_woven_drai: Drain multiplier with a Seam-Woven Tether (0.75 = 25%% slower drain).
config.extremedimensions.woven_reach.des: Extra reach in blocks a woven Tether has in the Overworld before it snaps.
config.extremedimensions.woven_seam_seco: Extra seconds in the Seam per woven tier (Soul-Woven = 1, Seam-Woven = 2).
config.extremedimensions.scar_drain_redu: Drain reduction per scar, counting up to five scars (0.03 = 3%%). A scar is earned for every curse stack taken off.
config.extremedimensions.seam_seconds.de: Seconds a Seam Needle gives you in the Seam before it spits you out.
config.extremedimensions.storm_chance.de: Chance per Overworld player every minute, once the seal is broken, that a Wound Storm breaks out nearby (0.04 = 4%%).
config.extremedimensions.storm_cooldown_: Minimum minutes between two Wound Storms for the same player.
config.extremedimensions.storm_seconds.d: How long a Wound Storm lasts, in seconds (at least 10).
config.extremedimensions.starving_end_dr: Drain multiplier in the End while the seal is broken: the Pale Void starves (1.25 = 25%% faster drain).
config.extremedimensions.lurker_offering: Chance that a watching Lurker leaves an offering when it goes, once the seal is broken (0.3 = 30%%).
config.extremedimensions.mended_drain.de: Drain multiplier for everyone in a mended world (0.8 = 20%% slower drain).
config.extremedimensions.event_spacing.d: Seconds between two world events (a storm, a build, a fraying) for the same player. None starts during an Elder fight.
config.extremedimensions.echoes.desc: Whether a Collapse that ends in death beyond the wound leaves an echo there (1 on, 0 off).
config.extremedimensions.echo_delay.desc: Seconds after the Collapse before its echo shows.
config.extremedimensions.echo_range.desc: How near (blocks) a player must come for an echo to show.
config.extremedimensions.echo_listen_ran: How near (blocks) one must stand by an echo to listen to it.
config.extremedimensions.echo_listen_sec: Seconds of listening before the echo lets go.
config.extremedimensions.echo_drain.desc: Drain multiplier for everyone near while someone listens to an echo (not in a mended world).
config.extremedimensions.echo_drain_rang: How far (blocks) from a listened-to echo the faster drain reaches.
config.extremedimensions.echo_atone.desc: Atonement points the listener gains when an echo lets go (besides a Tether Fragment).
config.extremedimensions.echo_return.des: Share of the death's atonement loss the collapsed player gets back when their echo is heard out (0.5 = half).
config.extremedimensions.echo_pay_cooldo: Seconds before another's echo pays the same listener again (before then it still lets go, but for nothing).
config.extremedimensions.echo_max.desc: Most echoes a world keeps waiting; the oldest goes first.
config.extremedimensions.unstable_anchor: Whether anchors without a soul ward can crack in storms and after a Lurker drinks (1 on, 0 off).
config.extremedimensions.unstable_chance: Chance for each unwarded anchor near the start of a storm that it cracks (0.5 = 50%%).
How near (blocks) to the start of a storm an anchor can crack.

journal.extremedimensions.matriarch.text: Kill enough of her children's keepers and she comes herself. Taller than any Keeper, her mask cracked with age, her cloak the colour of old blood. She calls her brood to take what they can while she fights, and when she wails the light goes out of the world for a while. She is the oldest thing in the hollows. Perhaps the first one who stayed.
journal.extremedimensions.ferryman.title: 33. The Ferryman
journal.extremedimensions.ferryman.text: So that is who the pigmen pay. He comes for those who stay too long beyond the wound, poling his way through the heat to the toll of a single bell. While he walks, the thread drains as if it were paying him. Every blow costs you levels. Go home with him still walking and he takes his fare anyway. Stand and fight, and he forgets what you owe.
journal.extremedimensions.last_weaver.te: Not all of them finished weaving themselves into the seal. One waits in each village of the Thinned, half thread and half person, keeping what is left of its people. With the hunger at the Heart ended, they are waking. Its touch unpicks the thread that holds you in the Seam. End it, and the thread it was keeping is yours.

journal.extremedimensions.barter.title: 35. Small Bargains
journal.extremedimensions.barter.text: They remember. Every nugget I left by a hoard, every Hollowling I let run, every one I did not. Today one of them did not freeze when I looked at it. It came closer, held out a fragment of the Tether in its grey little hands, and waited. It wanted gold. Not much. A few nuggets, a shard of amethyst, things that shine. It gives what it finds, and it finds what we lose. I think the tribe is keeping count of me. I think I would like to be worth something to it.
journal.extremedimensions.raid.title: 36. The Raid
journal.extremedimensions.raid.text: It was not my hoard. I opened it anyway. They came out of the ground like ink out of a broken bottle, all of them at once, giggling, grabbing at everything I carried, and they did not freeze when I looked at them. Then the Keeper. When it fell the barrel was fuller than any I had seen: fragments, pages, emeralds, things the tribe had hidden away for a very long time. I took it all. Somewhere in the dark, someone is keeping count.

journal.extremedimensions.fray.title: 37. The Fray
journal.extremedimensions.fray.text: There is a well at the edge of some islands, a ring of stone around nothing. I dropped a lantern into one and watched it fall until the fog took it. Then I jumped. The Seam caught me, the way it catches dust, and let me down onto a knot of thread as big as a house, wound round stone, far below the islands. Strands run from knot to knot into the dark. Everything the Seam swallows ends up tangled here. My time ran through my fingers twice as fast, and the Thinned did not wait for me to grow weak. I crouched on the knot's glowing heart and the updraft carried me home.
journal.extremedimensions.frayed_ray.tex: The rays came down after me. I had thought them the gentlest things in the Seam, but these were not the rays I knew: their light had turned the green of a bruise going bad, and their eyes were coals. One cried out, climbed, folded its wings and fell on me like a stone. Its sting burned for a long while after. I think the Fray does to them what it does to everything that sinks into it. I did not stay to see what it would do to me.
journal.extremedimensions.held.title: 39. The Held
journal.extremedimensions.held.text: If you are reading this, you followed the chain. The other one never did. They stood at the gate with a hand on the warm links, wrote something in that little book, and walked away. I heard the footsteps go. I have held this chain since before the wounds had names. Not against anything. For someone. When the door was cut, someone had to keep it from swinging shut on those still on the other side, and a chain was all there was. My hands are bone now. They still know how to hold. Take it. It will hold you as it held me: a little longer than it should, and never long enough. And when you read that book again, read it in my hand as well. Whoever wrote it was not the first. Nobody who says so ever is.
journal.extremedimensions.echoes.title: 40. Echoes
journal.extremedimensions.echoes.text: Where one of us was dragged out, the place does not forget. I went back, once, to where a friend's thread ran dry. She was still there, kneeling, the chains held up as if someone would come for her. I stood by her until she let go. It cost me time I did not have. She left me something, and I think she left something for herself as well, wherever she was. The wound remembers us. I do not know yet whether that is a mercy.
journal.extremedimensions.frame.title: 41. The Frame
journal.extremedimensions.frame.text: Not empty. Unstrung. Put silk across it and it remembers: they came out of the dark one after another and stepped into the weave, and the weave closed behind them. The first of them did not step in. The first of them was tying something. Look for the rest where the piglins keep their gold, where the cities of the End keep theirs, and on the looms in the Seam where nobody weaves any more. Then go down. The thread runs deeper than the Wanderer ever went.
journal.extremedimensions.first_knot.tex: A knot the size of a hall, and the strands of the whole Seam running into it. It was tied, not grown. Something is tied into it as well, at its heart, and it is not asleep. The Wanderer wrote that they were the first. The Weavers say nothing; they are woven. I say this: whoever tied this knot is still holding the end of it.
journal.extremedimensions.continued_mend: The Wanderer's ink stops where mine starts. The wound is shut, and the world is already forgetting it was ever open: the storms do not come, the young of the tribe leave things on the doorstep, and the drain is a whisper where it was a pull. But a seam is never gone, only sewn. I have built a loom from the Weavers' own pillars, and I mean to weave down what we did, deed by deed, before the world forgets that too. Six panels. When the last is set, I think the wounds will remember us one last time, all at once. Let them. I will be at the loom.
journal.extremedimensions.continued_seve: The Wanderer's ink stops where mine starts. The Tether is cut, and the seconds no longer run out beyond the wound. Nothing calls us home now, and nothing will catch us if we fall: whoever falls there keeps nothing. I have built a loom from the Weavers' own pillars, because a world with no thread to hold it needs something woven instead. What we did, deed by deed, so that it is kept somewhere. Six panels. When the last is set, I think the wounds will come for the loom, all at once. Let them. I will be at the loom.
journal.extremedimensions.note.ruined_ga: Still warm. You looked longer than they did.
journal.extremedimensions.note.wanderer: First? I tied my cord before you were born.
journal.extremedimensions.note.first_wou: A door. Yes. Ask who held it open.
journal.extremedimensions.note.unanchore: They finish only when no one is looking. I looked, for a hundred years.
gui.extremedimensions.path.title: The Path
gui.extremedimensions.path.seam.craft: Craft a Seam Needle from 2 Tether Fragments, a Wanderer's Page and an Echo Shard (keep a page unread for it). Monsters slain beyond the wound drop fragments; pages lie in the chests of ruined portals, fortresses and strongholds; Echo Shards in the Ancient Cities deep below.
gui.extremedimensions.path.seam.tear: Use the Seam Needle on Crying Obsidian, in the Overworld or the Nether, with room in front of it, and walk into the tear before it closes. Crying Obsidian lies at ruined portals; piglins trade it.
gui.extremedimensions.path.seam_home: The gate you stepped out of is the way home: walk back into the rift between its pylons before your time runs out. Lost sight of it? Follow the arrow on your bar.
gui.extremedimensions.path.seal: The Ender Dragon is the lock on the first wound. Slay it, and the wound opens wider. Ready a Void Anchor with plenty of charge first: the End lies beyond the wound too.
gui.extremedimensions.path.heart: Since the seal broke, every rift into the Seam opens at its Heart. Tear one with a Seam Needle; what waits there came through the first wound.
gui.extremedimensions.path.starved: The Starved One waits at the Heart. Feed Seam Silk to its pedestals: while two burn, it stands still and takes double damage. A Hollowling at your side and a woven Tether make it easier.
gui.extremedimensions.path.choose: The Mending Thread and the Severing Shears lie at the altar of the Heart. Only one of the two can ever be used, and it decides for the whole world.
gui.extremedimensions.path.choose.held: You carry what decides the world. The Thread mends the first wound: the world grows calm and the tribe makes peace. The Shears sever the Tether from the world: no more time running out beyond the wound, but who falls there keeps nothing. Only one can ever be used.
gui.extremedimensions.path.beyond: The Wanderer's path ends here; yours does not. Pacts are open now, the Last Weaver can wake in the villages of the Thinned, and a Weaver's Loom will hold what you do next.
gui.extremedimensions.frame.strung: The frame is strung. Its thread is with you already.
gui.extremedimensions.frame.more_silk: It takes %s Seam Silk to string the frame.
gui.extremedimensions.frame.shows: The strung frame remembers what it held...
gui.extremedimensions.loom.tapestry: On the loom, a half-woven tapestry: a figure tying the first knot. A thread comes loose in your hand.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.deed.chai: Find the Held's chamber at the end of a warm chain.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.deed.knot: Slay the Knot Mother, deep in the Fray.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.deed.hear: Choose the ending: mend the first wound or sever the Tether.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.boon.root: Your Hollowling brings gifts %s times as often.
The tribe sends no Keeper after anyone, however it hates them.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.boon.toll: %s level back on every safe return.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.boon.unra: The Thinned hunt only in your last 1/%s of Seam time.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.boon.knot: Seam time runs out %s times as fast in the Fray, not %s.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.boon.hear: An echo of a Collapse gives back %s%% of what it cost.
Once every %s minutes, a fall beyond the wound keeps what you carried.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.world_une: Not finished: the loom will not take a thread before the ending.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.world_men: A mended world: each panel gives what a mended world can.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.world_sev: A severed world: each panel gives what a severed world can.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.status_we: The Weaving is under way. Hold the loom!
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.status_ag: %s unravelled. The loom takes it again in %s min.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.state_car: Thread in hand. It waits for the ending.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.state_los: Thread lost: %s Seam Silk spins it back.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.new_threa: Thread %s for the whole world: the Elders grow %s%% stronger and atonement %s%% dearer, the Matriarch comes again, and the Rift Trials go on past gold. The tapestry stays. There is no way back.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.other_loo: The tapestry hangs on another loom, at %s %s %s.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.not_yet: Not yet. It is not finished.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.busy: Not while the Weaving goes on.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.not_again: The loom will not take it again yet (%s min).
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.more_silk: It takes %s Seam Silk to spin the %s back.
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.spared: The Heart panel holds: this fall keeps what you carried. (Again in %s minutes.)
gui.extremedimensions.tapestry.new_threa: %s takes up a new thread. Thread %s: the Elders are stronger, atonement dearer, and the trials have no end.
gui.extremedimensions.weaving.begins: The last panel is set. The wounds converge on the loom: hold it until the weave is done!
gui.extremedimensions.weaving.held: The weave holds. The tapestry is finished, and the story is yours.
gui.extremedimensions.weaving.failed: The ward breaks. The %s panel unravels; the loom takes it again in %s minutes.
gui.extremedimensions.first_knot.reached: The First Knot. Something is tied into its heart.
gui.extremedimensions.first_knot.resting: The knot is pulled tight. What was tied into it has not come back yet.
gui.extremedimensions.plumb.down: The line pulls straight down. Find a well to the Fray.
gui.extremedimensions.plumb.here: The line hangs straight: you are at the knot.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.collapse.text: Your charge ran out and the Tether pulled you down. A curse follows you home: you choose which, from the cards.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.curse.title: Curses
gui.extremedimensions.hint.curse.text: A curse stays until lifted: by atonement earned beyond the wound, or Tether Fragments offered at an anchor. See them under Curses in your inventory.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.fragment.text: Offer fragments at an anchor to lift a curse, one per stack. Two, a Wanderer's Page and an Echo Shard make a Seam Needle.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.lurker.title: The Lurker
gui.extremedimensions.hint.lurker.text: It stalks what does not look at it. Turn around when your animals grow restless; strike first and it flees.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.hoard.title: A hoard
gui.extremedimensions.hint.hoard.text: What the tribe steals ends up here. Take it back, but opening it wakes its Keeper.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.relic.title: A relic
gui.extremedimensions.hint.relic.text: Use it at home to bind it to your Tether. Each gives and each takes; a bound relic is never lost.
gui.extremedimensions.choice.forced: No choice. The abyss chose for you.
gui.extremedimensions.abyssal.broken: %1$s breaks. It no longer holds you.
gui.extremedimensions.abyssal.cloth: The cloth will not take %s. Break it, or atone.
gui.extremedimensions.abyssal.hungering: The Starved took %s × %s from your bag.
gui.extremedimensions.abyssal.gravebound: You wake where it all began.
gui.extremedimensions.abyssal.lockjaw: Your jaw will not open with them this close.
gui.extremedimensions.abyssal.blood_jump: The blood price: the stack leaps onto %s.
gui.extremedimensions.abyssal.lightless_: You slept. The nights you kept are forgotten.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.abyssal.title: An abyssal curse
gui.extremedimensions.hint.abyssal.text: No cloth and no friend takes it from you. Its deed breaks it: read it under Curses, in the Extreme tab.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.needle.title: Seam Needle
gui.extremedimensions.hint.needle.text: Use it on Crying Obsidian in the Overworld or the Nether, then walk into the tear. The gate you arrive at leads home.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.silk.title: Seam Silk
gui.extremedimensions.hint.silk.text: It weaves stronger Tethers and cheaper Seam Needles. The recipe book shows what it makes.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.elder.title: An Elder
gui.extremedimensions.hint.elder.text: Nothing can hurt it while it forms. Use these seconds to choose your ground.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.storm.title: A Wound Storm
gui.extremedimensions.hint.storm.text: Things slip through behind you. Fight with your back to a wall; the storm stops when you leave the Overworld.
gui.extremedimensions.hint.fallen.title: Fallen
gui.extremedimensions.hint.fallen.text: An ally who crouches beside you for 4 seconds lifts you up. Hold sneak for 3 seconds to give in.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.unseen_te: The page is blank. Whatever belongs here, you have not met it yet.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.notes_loc: Slay %s more to learn how to face it.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.noted: Your journal now knows how to face %s.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.lurker.lo: Tall, thin and grey as smoke, it stands where the light gives out and watches. It wants what you carry: your things, your memories, the light in your anchors. Look away and it is closer.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.lurker.no: Soul light keeps it from your anchors. Once it has taken something it flees: catch it before it vanishes and it drops what it took.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.hollowlin: The young of the tribe: small, quick and giggling. They freeze when you look at them, steal small things when you don't, and carry them home to their hoard.
They never take tools, armour or anything of the Tether. Small shiny gifts win the tribe over; a Tether Fragment in soul light may win a companion. Killing them costs dearly.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.keeper.lo: The guardian of a hoard: a Lurker grown huge and patient. Open what it keeps, or hurt its young, and it comes for you, screeching darkness.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.keeper.no: It blinks behind you when you run and its screech slows you: keep it in sight and fight close. Go far enough from its hoard and it gives up.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.starved_o: What came through the first wound, and what the tribe has hidden from ever since. Gaunt, enormous and always hungry, it drinks time itself.
It grows stronger for every player at the Heart. Bring light, armour and patience: it is the end of the Mending, not the start.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.thinned.l: What is left of the Weavers' people, worn to threads, still walking the streets of their villages in the Seam. They mean nothing by their watching, until your thread runs thin.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.thinned.n: They only move while nobody looks at them: keep them in sight and back away. In the Fray they hunt from the start. They carry Seam Silk.
Great pale rays that glide high over the islands of the Seam, trailing light. They circle every visitor, curious, and mean no harm.
Brought down, they give Seam Silk, glow ink and their wings. A Veil Wing mends what the Seam unravels.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.frayed_ra: Veil Rays that sank into the Fray and came back wrong. Their light has gone sick and green, their eyes red. They fly faster than their kin above, climb over whoever comes down, fold their wings and dive.

Listen for the cry: it comes before the climb. Step aside as it folds its wings, or strike it as it pulls away. Its sting poisons. When the dark closes in, they all come at once. They carry more silk than the rays above.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.matriarch: The mother of the hollows: a weeping mask of carved wood on a body of roots and bark, tall as a tree. She guards her hoards herself once too many Keepers have fallen.
Watch the ground: every blow is foretold by her sigil. Jump her rings. Her brood steals while she fights, so guard your pockets.
The ferryman of the Nether's last river: hooded, with a skull beneath and soul fire in its sockets. He asks a toll of every soul that crosses, and takes it whether you pay or not.
Every blow he lands takes its toll. His chains pull you in and his cage crushes inward: break his line of sight and keep moving.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.weaver.lo: The last of the Weavers who sewed the Seam shut. Gowned in silk and light, a gem for an eye, she unpicks what visitors weave, and the time they carry.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.weaver.no: Her threads pull taut before they cut: step off the line. Her blows take Seam time. The Seraphic Lance is foretold by a line of light on the ground: get out of its path.
gui.extremedimensions.bestiary.knot_moth: What is tied into the First Knot, deep in the Fray. She has a Weaver's shape, frayed to the colours of the deep, and she does not let go of the end she holds. Whether she is the First Weaver, what the Fray made of her, or someone else, the journal does not say.

She fights as the Last Weaver does, in the Knot's own chamber: step off her threads, watch the floor for the Lance, and keep out from under her when she unravels. Her blows take Seam time, and the Fray already runs it out twice as fast.
gui.extremedimensions.ledger.page.close: Every number here is a night I lived through.

tooltip.extremedimensions.spindle.1: Load it with Tether Fragments and Seam Silk, then turn it with an empty hand until it gives up a Tether Cord. Crouch to load a whole stack.
tooltip.extremedimensions.spindle.2: What was frayed can be spun again. Not mended, only spun.
Found only deep in the hearts of the Seam's islands and in the stone of the Fray's knots. Smelt it for scrap.
Every Tether the Fray ever swallowed ends up somewhere.
tooltip.extremedimensions.tetherite_scra: Four of it and four Tether Cord make a Tetherite Ingot.
It hums when you hold it near a Tether.
tooltip.extremedimensions.tether_cord.1: Tether Fragments spun with Seam Silk on a Spindle. Binds Tetherite Scrap into an ingot.
tooltip.extremedimensions.tether_cord.2: Tighter than it was before it frayed.
tooltip.extremedimensions.tetherite_ingo: With an upgrade template, takes netherite gear one step further at a smithing table. Also a trim material.
Heavier than it looks, as if something were still holding on to it.
tooltip.extremedimensions.tetherite.teth: Tethered: if it falls into the void, it comes back to you
